title: AI chip stocks pull the market back down
summary: A day after a huge rally, chip stocks fell. NVIDIA dropped about 6%, AMD almost 9% and Broadcom about 4%. The S&P 500 slipped 0.5% and the Nasdaq fell 1.5%, while the Dow rose about 0.9% thanks to stocks like Amgen and Nike.
why: When a stock jumps a lot in one day, some investors sell to lock in their gains. That is called profit-taking. It shows why one great day does not mean the worries are gone.

title: Sanofi agrees to buy Insmed for about $41 billion
summary: French drug maker Sanofi agreed to buy Insmed for $175 per share in cash. That is about 46% more than Insmed's price before news of talks came out. The deal is expected to close in the first half of 2027 if regulators and shareholders approve it.
why: Big deals like this show that large drug companies are willing to pay a lot for new medicines. That helped lift many health care stocks today, including Eli Lilly and Intuitive Surgical.

title: Short trading week for Thanksgiving
summary: U.S. stock markets are closed on Thursday, November 26, for Thanksgiving. On Friday, November 27, they close early at 1 p.m. Eastern time.
why: Fewer people trade around holidays. With fewer buyers and sellers, prices can sometimes jump more than usual on small news.

title: NVIDIA brings back Jensen Huang as CEO
summary: NVIDIA's board voted unanimously to put Jensen Huang back in charge as president and CEO, and back on the board. He had stepped down on November 12. The board says its internal review will keep going until it is finished.
why: Investors often worry when a company loses its founder or leader. Getting him back removed a big worry, and the stock jumped about 31% in one day before falling about 6% on Tuesday.
source: NVIDIA press release filed with the SEC
